item.title: Blit 0.2.48
item.description: Torrent status in seedbox folders: what qBittorrent is doing with each item, downloading with time left, stalled, stopped, or seeding with its time and ratio. Downloads arrive with a still from the video, Quick Look and Rename in the notification, and a note when an episode is missing (only when Blit is sure). And after four hours away, a summary of what happened while you were gone.
